array.string: export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; URLF=/tmp/crossade-table-url; LOG=/tmp/crossade-table-tunnel.log; : > $LOG; cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:2590 --no-autoupdate > $LOG 2>&1 & T=$!; trap "kill $T" EXIT; URL=; for i in $(seq 60); do sleep 1; URL=$(grep -o "https://[a-z0-9-]*\.trycloudflare\.com" $LOG | grep -v "^https://api\." | tail -1); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; done; [ -n "$URL" ] || exit 1; echo "туннель стола: $URL"; if [ "$(cat $URLF 2>/dev/null)" != "$URL" ]; then echo "$URL" > $URLF; launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.crossade.table || true; fi; wait $T
